meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面（英语二图表作文：某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比，未注明年份）

band.rationale: 对照第2节档位描述：本文"基本完成了试题规定的任务"——图表三组数据（35%从未参加、45%每月1-2次、20%3次及以上）均有覆盖，并给出原因与评论，内容要点多数齐全；采用 Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 等简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰；但"有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误"（主谓一致、does not provides、逗号粘连、learn skill/make friend、percentage 三度误用），虽不影响理解。未达第四档：第四档要求"语言基本准确，只有在试图使用较复杂结构或较高级词汇时才有个别错误"，而本文错误多为低阶基础错误且三段皆有；也未落入第二档：信息传达清楚，不存在"影响了对写作内容的理解"的问题。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month. Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三组数据均覆盖且数值正确，但未点明这是"占比"结构，缺少一句总体概括（如：多数学生每月参加不足三次），"从未参加"与"3次及以上"两处未交代按月统计口径，描述停留在报数层面。

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: There are many reasons for this phenomonon. Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work... Secondly, the school does not provides enough information... The school should offer more chances and students should balance...
dimensions.deduction_reason: 两个原因与学校、学生双方的建议均在，评论部分成立；但每个论点仅一句即止，未回扣图表数据深化论证，benefits 一句较笼统。

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: Firstly, some students think study is more important... Secondly, the school does not provides... In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students. ... Only in this way can we grow up better.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段式"描述—原因—评论"结构清晰（脚本段落字数 47/45/43 均衡），衔接词简单有效；但第二段逗号粘连使段内连贯受损。

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: volunteer activities is good for students; the school does not provides enough information; ...volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join; balance the the study
dimensions.deduction_reason: 基础错误贯穿三段：主谓一致（activities is）、助动词后未用原形（does not provides）、逗号粘连、可数名词单复数（learn skill / make friend）、相邻重复 the the；虽有 while 对比与 Only in this way 倒装等句式变化，整体控制力不足。

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students; It can help us learn skill and make friend; Only in this way can we grow up better.
dimensions.deduction_reason: percent/percentage 混用贯穿三处数据描述，属核心场景用词错误；join/take part in 与频次搭配不当，make friend、grow up better 等搭配生硬，词汇量明显有限。

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students... There are many reasons... In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 议论文体格式正确，三段齐整，脚本未报格式类硬性违规；字数 135 略低于建议 150（比例 0.9，soft_ok），按规则不机械罚分，仅在批改中提示。

consistency.adjustments: 初次拟定切题与图表解读 3.5、其余维度同上时合计 9.5，超出第三档上限 9；对照档位描述复核，因描述未点明占比框架且缺总体概括句，将切题与图表解读下调至 3.0，合计 9.0，落在 7-9 区间内。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: the situation of students taking part in 属中式直译，语义笼统，未能体现"每月频次"这一图表主题；语法上可以成立。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 是名词"百分比（概念）"，数目后应直接用 percent；另 take part in one to two times 缺少宾语、动词与频次搭配不当。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them do so one to two times every month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: 20 percentage students 应为 20 percent of the students；join 表"加入（成为一员）"，不能直接接频次 three times。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students take part in volunteer activities three times or more a month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，应为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: 裸单数 study 略生硬，their studies 更自然；原句并无错误，仅供参考。
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students think their studies are more important than volunteer work, so they spend almost all their spare time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: 助动词 does not 后动词须用原形 provide；两个独立分句仅用逗号连接构成逗号粘连，需加连词 so 或拆句。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students don't know how to join in.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主谓一致错误：复数主语 volunteer activities 应接 are。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: 可数名词单复数错误：learn skill 应为 learn skills，make friend 应为 make friends。
sentence_edits.revised: It can help us learn new skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: 相邻重复冠词 the the（与预检标记一致）；且 balance the study 中冠词多余，用 their studies 更顺。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances, and students should balance their studies and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: grow up 指未成年人的"长大"，用于大学生"发展得更好"属直译；倒装句式本身使用正确。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we develop ourselves more fully.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a university take part in volunteer activities every month. Specifically, 35 percent of them never take part in such activities, 45 percent do so one to two times a month, and only 20 percent join in three times or more.

There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students think their studies are more important than volunteer work, so they spend almost all their spare time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students simply do not know how to join in.

In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students. They help us learn practical skills, make new friends and better understand society. Therefore, the school should offer more opportunities, and students should learn to balance their studies and volunteer work. Only in this way can we make our university life more meaningful.
top_problems: 基础语法错误密集且遍布三段：主谓一致（volunteer activities is）、助动词后形式（does not provides）、逗号粘连、单复数（learn skill / make friend）、the the 重复，是最压分的一层。
图表描述核心用词失准：percentage 三次当 percent 使用，加上 join / take part in 与频次搭配不当，直接削弱第一段的任务完成质量。
词汇与表达有限：the situation of、grow up better 等中式直译，论证每点一句即止，且字数 135 略低于建议的 150 词（soft_ok，不机械罚分）。
practice_advice: 每天用"数字 + percent of the students + 动词"句型默写三句图表数据描述（覆盖"从未/1-2次/3次及以上"三类），写完逐句自查三件事：主语复数动词是否用 are、does not 后是否用原形、可数名词是否加了复数，两周即可消灭本文最集中的基础错误。

patterns: The chart shows how often ... take part in ...
Specifically, X percent of ..., while Y percent ...
There are many reasons for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
Only in this way can we ...
